tvShow.name: Marshals
tvShow.overview: With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.

episodes.name: Piya Wiconi
episodes.overview: Kayce Dutton reunites with an old SEAL teammate and aids his Marshal unit in hunting down a bomber targeting Broken Rock Reservation. The trail leads to a dangerous encounter with an armed anti-government militia.

episodes.name: Zone of Death
episodes.overview: As Kayce tries to embrace his new beginning, a Marshals op to stop a domestic terror attack lands him in a valley of buried Dutton family skeletons. While confronting his past he must also learn to ingratiate himself with his new Marshals teammates

episodes.name: Road to Nowhere
episodes.overview: When a standoff between Broken Rock and local ranchers over a mine groundbreaking turns violent, the Marshals lead a manhunt to find the shooters.

episodes.name: The Gathering Storm
episodes.overview: Kayce and Cal search for the survivors of a helicopter crash while the rest of the team tries to clear Kayce's name in a use of force complaint. While on the search Kayce and Cal encounter a wanted felon and the harsh nature of Montana's wilderness.

episodes.name: Lost Girls (1)
episodes.overview: When Kayce and Tate cross paths with an old friend of Tate's from the rez, Hayley, who exhibits behavior consistent with a trafficking victim, Kayce throws himself into tracking her down rather than committing to commemorating Monica.

episodes.name: Out of the Shadows (2)
episodes.overview: After losing the trail of teen trafficking victims, Kayce must tell Tate that his friend may be gone for good. When the Marshals learn the girls are in the hands of a violent motorcycle gang, they launch a dangerous op to infiltrate the gang.

episodes.name: Family Business
episodes.overview: When a federal judge and her family are the targets of a car bomb, the Marshals are assigned to guard them. Family secrets start to surface as the Marshals start to look into why someone would want this family dead.

episodes.name: Blowback (1)
episodes.overview: The Marshals go manhunting after receiving a tip that a dangerous fugitive is on the loose. Kayce and Cal struggle to reckon with their time at war when a former SEAL brother, Garrett, drifts back into their lives as they hunt a vicious enemy.

episodes.name: In Low Places (2)
episodes.overview: With one of their own taken prisoner, the Marshals strategize a risky assault on a paramilitary compound; outmanned, outgunned and with time rapidly running out, Kayce leads the team straight into the fire, risking everything to save their teammate.

episodes.name: Playing with Fire (1)
episodes.overview: After a prison bus crash, two Marshals face ghosts from the past when the team splits up to hunt down the escapees and triage the injured.

episodes.name: On Thin Ice (2)
episodes.overview: With a dangerous prison escapee in tow, Kayce and Cal struggle to survive a freezing night on a mountain, a task made all the more challenging by an unhealed wound from their past that threatens their ability to work as a team in the present.

episodes.name: The Devil at Home
episodes.overview: As they uncover a drug cartel targeting the Broken Rock Reservation, the Marshals race to locate Miles, only to discover that he has gone rogue to hunt down a trafficker.

episodes.name: Wolves at the Door
episodes.overview: After an assassination attempt against Broken Rock chairman Rainwater, Kayce protects him while the Marshals race to discover who's targeting him. When a militia attacks, Kayce realizes the conspiracy is larger than anyone imagined.

reviews.author: Johan
reviews.content:
I wanted to like this show, the idea sounded good on paper, but oh boy it's pretty awful. You have Kayce who is pretty dull, and I'm sorry but his kid who most certainly cannot act. And then he joins up a team of marshals, who of course have the powerful girl bosses who kick all them mens arses at their leisure. Also the script is seemingly written by first generation AI. For example, the bad guys in the second episode are just some mysterious organisation called the "Aryans". Oh please, cmon man, that was enough for us to turn the show off and we'll never return. So lame.

Decent scenery is the sole reason to watch the show. If you're looking for a clever story or interesting characters I'd recommend something else.

reviews.author: mychelove
reviews.content:
I never liked Kevin Costner too much, but the Yellowstone was actually quite solid.
They shouldn't have parasite on it.

Everything above shooting bad guys in the Marshals is unnecessary, empty and boring.
Guys would make a decent painball team, though.
